content.tagline: Korean men’s grooming care brand Scott Hamish
content.descriptor: Cheon365: Seoul company behind Scott Hamish, a Korean men’s grooming brand with toner and lotion essences, cleansing foam, sun care, hand cream and lip balm
about: Cheon365 Co., Ltd. is a company based in Seoul, Korea. According to the official Scott Hamish website, it operates the Scott Hamish brand.

Scott Hamish describes itself as a men’s grooming care brand that addresses the skin concerns of modern men. The brand concept draws on Scotland, and its website names the Scottish thistle as one of its ingredients.
This profile is based only on public information from the brand’s official website. Teranova has not independently verified it.
facts: Skincare, cleansing, sun care, hand and lip care
channels: Importers and distributors of men’s cosmetics

lines.name: Blue Blended essences
lines.note: According to the brand, all-in-one toner essence and lotion essence; the website lists hyaluronic acid, amino acids and milk thistle extract among the ingredients.

lines.name: Blue Freedom cleansing foam
lines.note: According to the brand, a deep-cleansing foam with BHA and plant capsules.

lines.name: BeBrave BB essence
lines.note: According to the brand, an all-in-one BB essence that combines sun protection, BB cream and essence.

lines.name: Classic Golf sun care
lines.note: According to the brand, a sun cream and a sun stick.

lines.name: Hand and lip care
lines.note: According to the brand, Claymore hand creams and Courage lip balm.
